operation_details.item: The user's Client A runs its finance systems on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How is the client work shaping up today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty well. I’m reviewing the finance-system notes across the client portfolio.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Anything notable in the system landscape?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes—Client A runs its finance systems on SAP. Client B uses Oracle, and Client C uses NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s useful context. Are those system details already captured in the client profiles?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the system details are recorded in the client profiles.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that Client A runs on SAP, while keeping the system details for Clients B and C.
